summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Winters Joint Unified School District to issue up to $29.9 million in bonds to repair, modernize, and replace school facilities and systems.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes $29.9 million in school bonds and the property taxes needed to repay them.
tax.quote: A "YES" vote is a vote to authorize the District to issue up to $29,900,000 in general obligation bonds and to levy the property tax necessary to repay them.
